title: Russian drone enters Polish airspace during attack on Ukraine
summary: A Russian drone violated Polish airspace during an attack on western Ukraine. Poland's military said they decided to refrain from using weapons due to the risk of causing damage to civilians.

title: Russian strikes on Zaporizhzhia leave two people killed, 11 injured, houses destroyed
summary: Two people were killed and 11 injured in a Russian attack on Zaporizhzhia, which damaged apartment buildings, private houses and a transport infrastructure facility.

title: Russia develops new reconnaissance version of Molniya drone with gasoline engine – presidential advisor
summary: Russian forces have developed a new reconnaissance version of the Molniya unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a gasoline engine.

title: Hungarian PM says he will visit Zakarpattia region soon
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar said on Monday that he would visit Ukraine's Zakarpattia region soon to express his support for the ethnic Hungarian minority living there.

title: Olga Kharlan calls on Melania Trump to help secure release of civilians from Kinburn Spit
summary: Olympic fencing champion Olga Kharlan, who hails from Mykolaiv, has appealed to U.S. First Lady Melania Trump to help secure the release of civilians from the temporarily occupied Kinburn Spit.

title: Estonia must get used to Ukrainian drone attacks in the Baltic Sea, Prime Minister says
summary: Estonian Prime Minister Kristen Michal said Ukraine’s attacks on Russian vessels in the Baltic Sea were understandable, adding that such attacks were something countries should get used to and be prepared for.

title: Ukraine's Defense Forces destroy 1,004 Russian tanks since start of 2026
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces have destroyed 1,004 Russian tanks since the beginning of 2026, equivalent to approximately six Eiffel Towers in terms of total metal weight.

title: Russia lacks capability to recover Kerch Bridge spans from seabed – Ukrainian Navy spokesperson
summary: Russia lacks the capability to raise the spans of the Kerch Bridge from the seabed, while foreign companies are unlikely to take part in the operation because the area is an active combat zone.

title: Injury toll in Russian strike on Dnipro apartment building rises to six
summary: Russian forces launched nearly 30 attacks on Dnipropetrovsk region throughout the day, injuring six people in the city of Dnipro.

title: Ukraine to scale up DESNA air defense launcher production jointly with Norway
summary: Ukraine and Norway have jointly developed the DESNA air defense launcher and are now working to scale up its production and deployment. The system is already in service with Ukraine’s forces.

title: Kyiv Appeals Court upholds detention of woman accused of posing as paramedic during clashes at National Guard facility
summary: The Kyiv Court of Appeal has upheld the pretrial detention without bail of a woman suspected of obstructing the operations of a National Guard of Ukraine unit in Kyiv region.

title: Russia has targeted Naftogaz facilities more than 800 times since the full-scale invasion
summary: Russian forces have carried out more than 800 attacks on Naftogaz Group facilities since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: Two women injured as Russian drone hits homes and shop in Chernihiv Region
summary: A Russian drone strike has damaged several private homes and a shop in the town of Snovsk, in the Koriukivka district of Chernihiv Region, leaving two women injured.

title: Intelligence warns of potential Russian attacks on British companies supporting Ukraine – media
summary: British companies and organisations providing assistance to Ukraine’s Defense Forces, including by supplying weapons components and equipment or providing logistical support, have been warned by the government that they could become targets of Russian sabotage.

title: Italy’s Foreign Minister voices concern over Ukraine’s strike on Russian vessels in Libya
summary: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani has voiced concern to his Ukrainian counterpart, Andrii Sybiha, over Ukraine’s attack on Russian vessels in the Libyan port of Benghazi.

title: Magyar reports significant progress in talks with Ukraine on rights of Hungarian minority
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar said significant progress had been made in talks with the Ukrainian side on ten issues concerning the language, cultural and educational rights of the Hungarian national minority in Ukraine.

title: Zelensky makes first statement after meeting with Magyar in Uzhhorod
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky made his first statement to the press after paying tribute to fallen Ukrainian soldiers in Uzhhorod alongside Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar.

title: UK defence secretary visits Kharkiv, announces additional RapidRanger launchers for Ukraine
summary: UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting visited the Ukrainian city of Kharkiv, located just 20 kilometers from the front line.

title: Zelensky and Magyar pay tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky and Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar paid tribute to fallen Ukrainian defenders in Uzhhorod.

title: Hungarian Prime Minister arrives in Zakarpattia
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Péter Magyar arrived in Ukraine's Zakarpattia (Transcarpathia) region on November 24 to meet with representatives of the local Hungarian community and separately with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

title: Latvian President sees potential turning point in Ukraine war next year
summary: Russia's war against Ukraine could reach a turning point next year, potentially leading to Moscow's defeat as the Russian economy deteriorates and international pressure mounts.

title: Blocked Kerch Strait further traps Russia's Black Sea Fleet – Ukrainian Navy Spokesperson
summary: The ability of the Russian Black Sea Fleet to maneuver and leave the Black Sea has been further restricted by the closure of the Kerch Strait.

title: Sybiha, Tajani discuss security in Black and Mediterranean Seas following strikes on Russian vessels off Libya
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha and his Italian counterpart Antonio Tajani discussed security challenges in the Black and the Mediterranean Seas, freedom of navigation, and diplomatic efforts to end Russia's war against Ukraine.

title: Zelensky confirms strike on Russian ship in Gulf of Finland
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has confirmed that Ukraine struck the Russian cargo ship Sparta II with a drone in the Gulf of Finland on Saturday, November 21.

title: Ukraine to issue formal protest to IAEA over appointment of sanctioned Russian official as Grossi's deputy
summary: Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha has instructed diplomats to issue a formal demarche to the International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and deliver a note of protest over the appointment of Alexei Ferapontov, deputy head of Russia's Federal Environmental, Industrial and Nuclear Supervision Service (Rostekhnadzor), as a deputy director general.

title: Zelensky to reach out to new US Congress if Trump fails to reach deal with Putin to end war
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky plans to reach out to the new Democrat-controlled U.S. Congress to intensify pressure on Russia if President Donald Trump fails to convince Vladimir Putin to end the war by the end of the year.

title: Norway in talks with Ukraine over attacks on Russian ships and regional stability
summary: Norwegian Defense Minister Tore Sandvik said on Tuesday, November 24, that Oslo was holding talks with Ukraine on the “need for stability in our near areas.”

title: Russian drone attack on Korosten railway station kills one, injury toll rises to three
summary: Russian forces attacked a railway station in Korosten, Zhytomyr region, with a drone, killing one person and injuring three others.

title: Hospital damaged in Russian attack on Odesa
summary: A municipal hospital building in Odesa was damaged in a Russian attack on the afternoon of November 24.

title: Ukrainian forces hit Russian military truck concentration area in Bryansk region
summary: Ukraine's Defense Forces struck an area where Russian military trucks were concentrated near Berestok in Russia's Bryansk region on November 23 and overnight into November 24.

title: Ukraine has right to strike military targets in Russia, but war must not spread to Baltic Sea – Pistorius
summary: German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius has reaffirmed Ukraine's right to strike military targets on Russian territory, while warning against the war spreading to the Baltic Sea and stressing Ukraine's particular responsibility in this regard.

title: Magyar leaves on first visit to Ukraine as prime minister
summary: Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar set off for Ukraine's Zakarpattia region on November 24, marking his first visit to the country since taking office.

title: Zelensky: Russia focused its attacks on Zhytomyr region last night, defenses worked
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said that Russian forces focused their attacks on the Zhytomyr region last night, targeting electricity distribution and transmission infrastructure.

title: European Council to discuss Ukraine’s 2027 funding needs on November 26–27
summary: A special meeting of the European Council will take place in Brussels on November 26–27. Alongside discussions on the EU’s next long-term budget, leaders will consider ways to meet Ukraine’s financial needs in 2027 and beyond.

title: Russian drone hits railway station in Korosten, killing one and injuring two
summary: A Russian drone struck a railway station in Korosten, Zhytomyr region, killing one person and injuring two others.

title: Ukraine-Poland relations will remain a “roller coaster”, former FM says
summary: Relations between Ukraine and Poland are likely to remain challenging. Their future will depend on whether the two countries can move beyond historical disputes and acknowledge Ukraine’s new role and agency. At the same time, the two countries have compelling strategic reasons to work together.

title: Ukraine’s right to self-defense is not geographically restricted, Foreign Ministry says on strikes against Russian vessels
summary: The threat to Libya comes from Russian warships and weapons carriers, not Ukraine, whose actions are directed solely against the aggressor in exercise of its inherent right to self-defense.

title: Hegseth yet to approve transfer of Patriot missiles already allocated to Ukraine – FT
summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has yet to authorize the transfer of around 60 PAC-3 and PAC-2 interceptor missiles for Patriot air defense systems to Ukraine, even though Kyiv’s Western allies have already paid for them.
